  • Admin access to your Facebook Business Manager or LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or permission to set them up for you.
  • A monthly ad budget you are comfortable testing with, paid directly to the platform.
  • Real photos or short videos of your team and work.
  • A person who will call or text leads quickly. Fast follow-up matters as much as the ad itself; our guide on automating lead follow-up shows how.

When social ads are the wrong fit

If people search for your service when they need it urgently, such as emergency plumbing or towing, search ads usually come first; see PPC management. If your website is slow or confusing, fix that before paying for traffic with conversion optimization. Social ads work best for services people plan ahead for, for visual work, and for reaching business owners on LinkedIn. Organic posting through social media management supports the ads by giving people a profile worth trusting when they click through. Not sure what to spend? Try the marketing budget calculator.

faq.q: Is the ad budget separate from the cost of social media advertising services?
faq.a: Yes. Your ad budget is paid directly to Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn, and our management work is quoted separately on the fit call.

faq.q: Who owns the ad account and audiences?
faq.a: You do. We work inside your business ad accounts with access you grant, so the pixel data, audiences and ad history stay with your business.

faq.q: How quickly do new social ad leads reach my team?
faq.a: Lead form submissions are routed to your CRM, email or phone as they come in, so your team can follow up while the person is still interested.

/services/social-media-growth.add:
What you get each month

  • A written content plan for the month ahead, with post topics, captions and the platform each post goes to, sent for your review before anything is published.
  • Posts built from your real work: job photos, team introductions, customer questions answered, seasonal reminders and short how-to tips your customers can use.
  • Google Business Profile posts and photo updates, which feed the same local search signals covered on our local SEO page.
  • Comment and message replies handled using answers you approve, with anything that needs a quote, a booking or a complaint routed to your team.
  • A short monthly report that shows reach, engagement and the posts that led to calls or messages, not just follower counts. We explain why that matters in what are vanity metrics.

How social media management works

  1. Fit call. A 15-minute call to see which platforms your customers actually use and what you want social to do for you.
  2. Profile cleanup. We fix bios, hours, links, cover images and categories so every profile matches your website and listings.
  3. Voice and topic list. We agree on how you sound, what you post about and what you never post about.
  4. Monthly calendar. You review and approve the plan. Changes are made before posting, not after.
  5. Publish, reply, report. We post on schedule, handle replies and send the monthly report with next month's adjustments.

What we need from you

Admin access to each profile, a shared folder where your team drops photos and short videos from the field, a list of your services and common customer questions, and one person who can approve the calendar each month. The more real photos you share, the better the posts perform, because people trust images of your actual crew and work over stock graphics.

Who it fits, and when it doesn't

This fits local and service businesses that do good work but rarely post, or that post in bursts and then go quiet for months. It is the wrong fit if you need leads this week; organic social builds trust over time. For faster reach, pair it with social media advertising. If you want someone on your own team to run social day to day, a dedicated social media assistant may suit you better. Graphics come from our graphic design work, so your posts match the rest of your brand.

faq.q: How much of my time do social media management services take?
faq.a: Usually a short monthly calendar review plus dropping photos into a shared folder as jobs happen. We handle writing, design, posting and routine replies.

faq.q: Do I approve posts before they go live?
faq.a: Yes. You see the full monthly calendar first, and nothing is published until you approve it or ask for changes.

faq.q: Will social media posting help my Google rankings?
faq.a: Google Business Profile posts and photos support your local presence directly. Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn posts mainly build trust and bring repeat visits rather than moving rankings on their own.

/services/speed-optimization.add:
What you get

  • A baseline report with your current Core Web Vitals and load times on mobile and desktop for your most visited pages, taken from Google's own testing tools.
  • A prioritized fix list showing what slows each page down and which fixes give the biggest gain for the least risk.
  • The fixes, done for you: resized and modern-format images, lazy loading, trimmed scripts and styles, removal of unused plugins, caching and CDN setup.
  • A before-and-after report using the same pages and tools as the baseline, so you can see what changed.
  • Notes for your team on how to add images and plugins later without slowing the site back down.

How website speed optimization works

  1. Measure. We test key pages, including your home page, top service pages and contact page, on mobile first.
  2. Diagnose. We trace each delay to its cause: images, third-party scripts, hosting, theme code or database.
  3. Back up. A full backup is taken before any change, so anything can be rolled back.
  4. Fix on staging when possible. Changes are tested on a copy of your site before going live.
  5. Verify. We re-test, check that forms, checkout and tracking still work, and send the report.

What we need from you

Admin access to your website and hosting account, a list of plugins, chat widgets and tracking tools you rely on, and a note of any pages that must not change. Some slow sites are held back by cheap hosting or a heavy page builder; if so, we explain the tradeoff and the options rather than patching around it.

How it connects to your other work

Speed supports both rankings and leads. It sits inside our technical SEO services and helps conversion optimization by keeping visitors from leaving before the page loads. If your site needs more than tuning, a rebuild through website development may cost less over time. To keep speed from drifting after the fix, CasperCare includes regular speed checks. You can get a quick read first with the free website grader or the 10-minute website audit.

faq.q: How do I know if I need a website speed optimization service?
faq.a: If your pages feel slow on a phone or Google Search Console flags Core Web Vitals issues, speed work is worth doing. A free test on your top pages shows where you stand.

faq.q: Will speed optimization break my website?
faq.a: We take a full backup first and test changes on a staging copy when your host allows it, then check forms and tracking after each change.

faq.q: Does my hosting affect site speed?
faq.a: Yes. Slow or overloaded hosting limits how fast any page can load, so we review your hosting as part of the diagnosis and explain your options.
